text:
andrew: Noticing a weird spike in provisioning failures in eu-west1 since ~02:12 UTC. GPUs stuck in 'attest_pending' and OOB shows a flurry of secureboot toggles on BMCs after the v2.15 firmware push.
tina: Wait we pushed v2.15 last night for a memory leak fix. It had an emergency recovery flow that flips secure_boot to false if mgmtd watchdog trips.
andrew: Exactly. But it looks like the recovery flow misfired on ~9 racks: logs show mgmtd watchdog -> recover -> secure_boot=false -> host attestation fails -> provisioner evicts GPUs. Sample: ```mgmtd: watchdog expire -> recovery(trigger=telemetry_overrun)
secureboot: set_state(false) (auto-recovery)
attestd: keymgr: attestation failed: secure_boot_disabled```
rachel: How many nodes affected and capacity hit?
ops-bot: ALERT: eu-west1/oob-secboot 02:14 -> 02:48: 9 racks toggled, 64 GPUs evicted, 220 allocation attempts queued. Autoscaler launched 3 additional nodes to satisfy demand.
lee: Oof. Was this limited to canaries? I thought v2.15 was staged.
tina: It was intended for 6 canaries. A job template mismatch meant the recovery flow flag shipped to a different label group (racks tagged 'staging' vs 'canary').
andrew: Immediate mitigation: re-enable secure_boot on affected BMCs and restart attestation service. I have a safe batch command: ```curl -X POST https://mgmt.api.local/batch/command -H "Authorization: Bearer $MGMT" -d '{"cmd":"secureboot set true && systemctl restart attestd"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'```
rachel: Please rate-limit the batch to 5/s — last time we hit the mgmt fabric and made it worse.
lee: I'll run it with --rate 5/s. Also need a temporary policy to prevent provisioner from evicting on attestation failure for 15m so we don't cascade. Can we toggle provisioner.sla.strict=false in region?
andrew: Yes, we can patch provisioner policy via config API: ```POST /config/regions/eu-west1 -d '{"provisioner.sla.strict": false, "eviction_grace": 900}'```
ops-bot: Batch secureboot re-enable job queued (job_eu_1714512345). 9/9 racks patched at 02:38 UTC, 0 failures. Provisioner policy patched at 02:40 UTC.
tina: After re-enabling, some hosts still showed stale attestation state. We had to restart attestation container on 12 VMs. Command: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/attest-service --field-selector=metadata.labels.rack in (rack-17,rack-21,...)`
andrew: Post-mortem notes so far: - tighten job label validation in deploy pipelines - remove auto-toggle of secure_boot from firmware recovery flow (or at least put behind explicit opt-in) - add a preflight that simulates attestation state change in canaries before fleet.
rachel: Monitoring additions: alert if secure_boot toggles >2/rack/hour and a preflight metric that checks job target count != intended target.
lee: Cost notes: autoscaler added ~3 warm nodes for ~35m -> estimated $420 extra in that window. Add to incident cost tracking.
tina: We should also add a soft-fail mode in provisioner that delays eviction for attestation failures <10m. That would reduce thrash.
andrew: Agreed. For now I'll schedule a rollback for v2.15 to only canaries and add the disable-auto-recovery patch. Rolling window: next 30m observation then decide.
ops-bot: Rollback initiated by tina at 02:52 UTC (rollback_job=rb_2026_02_52). platform-ci: CI job found template mismatch in pipeline -> PR opened: #4527.
rachel: Thanks team. Let's draft a short blameless incident note and sync with security for attestation audit. :white_check_mark:
